name: StyleCut
tagline: StyleCut lets you see how different hairstyles look on your own face before committing to a cut
description: StyleCut lets you see how different hairstyles look on your own face before committing to a cut. Upload a photo, choose from 70+ haircut directions — including bobs, bangs, fades, curls, and color changes — and get an AI-generated preview in seconds. Free to try, no sign-up required. Compare looks, save your favorites, and bring a clearer direction to your next salon visit.
